editor.description.shadowfilltime:
The time needed for the shadow to complete, from the image to the target shadow position.
Note that, in this case, the End Time will actually remove the shadow.
editor.description.outlinefilltime:
The time needed for the outline to complete, from the image to the target position.
Note that, in this case, the End Time will actually remove the outline.
editor.description.relativecoords: If the coordinates are relative, it means they get added to the image's current position, rather than declaring an absolute final position.

preferences.12hformat.description: If set to 'true', it'll change the clock format to 12h instead of 24h.
preferences.americandate.description: If set to 'true', it'll change the date format to MM/DD instead of DD/MM.
preferences.autoapps.description:
If set to 'true', it'll open a channel automatically when you click on them from the Main Menu

(So, it skips the banner)
preferences.showloadscreen.description:
If set to 'false', it'll skip the Warning screen.
IMPORTANT! If the app gets stuck or crashes, spam the home/back button when the app opens.
preferences.fullscreen.description: If set to 'true', it'll make the program go fullscreen.
preferences.numberofpages.description: It defines the number of pages the app can create on the home menu.
preferences.musicvolume.title: Music Volume
preferences.musicvolume.description: Lets you choose at what volume the background music should be.
preferences.sfxvolume.title: SFX Volume
preferences.sfxvolume.description: Lets you choose at what volume the sound effects should be.
preferences.language.title: Language
preferences.language.description: Allows you to change the app language
preferences.scale.title: Scale
preferences.scale.description: It allows you to change the window scale (1 being default, 0.25 smallest, 3 biggest)
preferences.wiimotes.title: Wiimotes
preferences.pairwiimotes.title: Pair Wiimotes
preferences.wiimotes.nunchunk.title: Nunchuck sensitivity
preferences.wiimotes.dpad.title: D-Pad sensitivity
preferences.wiimotes.nunchunk.descriptio: Changes the sensitivity of the Nunchuck when used to move the cursor.
preferences.wiimotes.dpad.description: Changes the sensitivity of the D-Pad when used to move the cursor.
preferences.showcursor.title: Show controller cursor?
preferences.showcursor.description: If set to 'true', it enables the cursor visibility in the app.
preferences.improvememory.title: Improve RAM usage?
preferences.improvememory.description:
The application will run optimizations on the animations during startup, as to use less RAM.
Disabling this will make the app load just a little faster, but it'll increase the risk of crashes.
preferences.fadeout.title: Transitions speed
preferences.fadeout.description: Changes the speed at which the screen transitions (black fadeouts) happen. Defaults to 1.
preferences.lowmemorymode.title: Low memory mode
preferences.lowmemorymode.description: If you enable this, the channel banners will only load upon request (for example, when opening a channel).
preferences.decimalstring.title: Fix decimal points
preferences.decimalstring.description:
If you enable this, the regular "text-based" keyboard will show up when inputting numbers in the editor, instead of the "number" keyboard.

Enable the option only if you can't input decimals in the editor at all.
preferences.fpslimit.title: FPS limit
preferences.fpslimit.description:
This setting allows you to reduce the amount of frames the app renders each second.

Having less FPS can help with phone overheat and stability.
preferences.gestures.title: Gestures
preferences.sdcard.title: Show SD card?
preferences.sdcard.description:
Displays the SD card button in the main menu.
You can perform the same action by holding the Revo button.
preferences.holdchannel.title: Hold channel to show its options
preferences.holdchannel.description:
This option enables the menu that appears when you hold a channel, which allows you to edit and delete it.
You can perform the same actions by lifting the channel and dragging it to the respective icons.
preferences.allowswipe.title: Swipe horizontally to change pages
preferences.allowswipe.description: This option enables you to swipe horizontally to change your current page in the Home Menu, as well as changing channels if you have one open.
preferences.allowswipevertical.title: Swipe vertically to close channel
preferences.allowswipevertical.descripti: This options enables you to swipe up/down to close a channel when it's open.
preferences.allowdrag.title: Touch with 2 fingers on channel to move it
preferences.allowdrag.description:
This option allows you to use 2 fingers in order to lift and move a channel.
This also lets you edit and delete the channel by dragging it to their respective buttons.
preferences.allowdoubleclick.title: Double click a channel to open directly
preferences.allowdoubleclick.description: This options allows you to skip a channel's banner by double clicking it, which will execute the action directly.
preferences.holdempty.title: Hold empty channel to create new channel
preferences.holdempty.description: This option allow you to hold an empty channel in order to create a new one in its place.
preferences.holdsdcard.title: Hold SD card to change its color
preferences.holdsdcard.description: This option allows you to hold the SD card button in order to change its color (blue - gray).
preferences.horizontal.title: Enable EXPERIMENTAL horizontal mode
preferences.horizontal.description:
This option allows you to enable an EXPERIMENTAL horizontal mode, which breaks pretty much every menu except the home menu.

This is just a PREVIEW and the rest of the app will be adapted to it in the future.

preferences.licenses.title: Licenses
preferences.standalonebrowser.title: Fix file pickers
preferences.standalonebrowser.descriptio:
This option replaces the native file + image picker with a standalone browser embedded in the app.

This could fix crashes that occur when the app imports or exports data.
preferences.autoloadanims.title: Load channels automatically?
preferences.autoloadanims.description: If enabled, the app will start loading channels automatically after the bootup sequence, instead of waiting for "Press (A)".
preferences.loadbannersatboot.title: Keep banners loaded?
preferences.loadbannersatboot.descriptio:
If enabled, the app will load the banners along with the icons in the app's boot sequence.
Be warned that this will increase the memory usage heavily.
preferences.navigationbar.title: Show navigation bar?
preferences.navigationbar.description: If enabled, the app will leave the fullscreen mode and allow Android to show the navigation bar buttons.
preferences.gridsize.title: Channel grid size
preferences.gridsize.description: With this option, you can either choose one of the default grid sizes, or define a custom one.
preferences.gridsizehorizontal.title: Number of apps (horizontal)
preferences.gridsizehorizontal.descripti:
Here you can define the number of apps that will be displayed in the grid horizontally.
This corresponds with the short-side of the device in portrait mode, and the long-side in landscape mode.
preferences.gridsizevertical.title: Number of apps (vertical)
preferences.gridsizevertical.description:
Here you can define the number of apps that will be displayed in the grid vertically.
This corresponds with the long-side of the device in portrait mode, and the short-side in landscape mode.
